episode_summary: In this episode, Bella Chaffey Lakic shares her journey from a young REALTOR with no sphere of influence to becoming an NAR 30 under 30 honoree. She discusses the power of YouTube for real estate marketing, the importance of creating engaging video content, and how community involvement can enhance your professional reputation. Bella also provides actionable insights on handling challenging real estate transactions and building a personal brand through consistent, high-quality content.
